item.title: Julia Margaret Cameron portraits 1864–1875, Victorian photography
item.description: Victorian portrait photography by Julia Margaret Cameron, who got her first camera at 48: soft focus on purpose, sitters like Charles Darwin and Alfred Tennyson. Public domain, free to download at Mosaic.

item.title: Alice Liddell as Pomona, Julia Margaret Cameron, 1872, Victorian portrait
item.description: Victorian portrait photography: Alice Liddell, who inspired Alice in Wonderland, posed as Pomona by Julia Margaret Cameron in 1872. Soft-focus 19th-century portrait, public domain, free to download at Mosaic.

item.title: Julia Margaret Cameron, Marie Spartali, 1870: Victorian soft-focus portrait photography
item.description: Marie Spartali photographed by Julia Margaret Cameron in 1870. Cameron got her first camera at 48 and used long exposures and shallow depth of field on purpose. Victorian portrait photography, public domain, free to download at Mosaic.
